ai_policy.summary: Sage permits disclosed generated text and research assistance, including literature support and AI-generated or checked code, with human verification. It prohibits analysis of experiences and themes and generating a submission through a series of prompts.

disclosure.instructions: Disclose generated content affecting methodology, analysis, results or conclusions at submission; describe appropriate research uses in methods or acknowledgements. Language, grammar and structure suggestions alone are exempt. Verify outputs and cite original sources.

restrictions: Do not generate a submission using a series of prompts.

Authors remain responsible; AI is not an author.
